purpose: Post-hoc attribution of the two largest native/public postpeak residuals in the third holdout. This is not a release gate or a waveform fit.
selection: These are the two rows with the largest public/native postpeak complex relative L2 in the already inspected parity result.

method.peak_alignment: For a separate shape diagnostic, shift each waveform by its own amplitude peak and divide its complex samples by its own complex peak value. No further time, phase, or amplitude optimization.
method.fixed_anchor_control: Retain the original frequency-crossing comparison and record its postpeak complex relative L2 unchanged.

qnm_control.method: Compare the native historical-spline QNM at the recorded native remnant against the pinned public from-final and binary-parameter QNM routines, as in the prior q4/q8 diagnostic.
